# Beebo Entertainment
> Free, local-first media server and apps: your own movies, TV, music, photos, audiobooks and live TV, streamed from your own computer to phones, TVs, cars and browsers, with camp and road-trip features. Beebo includes no movies or shows; you bring your own files. Video goes straight from your own computer to the viewer whenever possible; Beebo's servers carry only small text such as sign-in and connection set-up.

Status words used on this site: Available (in the current downloads and usable today), Beta (you can try it, still being tested on real equipment), In development (being built, not released), Planned (intended, no date). We never claim a flat "100% working".

## Current downloads
- Windows server 0.1.102: Available. Published Oct 24, 2026, 1:05 PM Eastern. Windows 10 and 11. Windows SmartScreen may show a warning the first time. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/windows.html
- Android phone and tablet app 1.51-tester34 (build 84): Available as a test download. Published Oct 21, 2026, 3:46 PM Eastern. Not on Google Play. Android TV layout: Beta, no real-TV test. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/app-on-your-phone.html
- Beebo Auto (Android Auto) 1.20 (build 21): Beta, a sideload test download. Published Oct 21, 2026, 6:52 AM Eastern. Not on Google Play. Beebo Auto 1.20 had one first look in one car on Oct 27, 2026 (the app appeared, four tabs and a TV episode with sound; next, previous, pause, steering-wheel buttons, search and any drive were not checked). An earlier build had one first check in one car on Oct 6, 2026 (sign-in, video list, sound, fast-forward). Video on the car screen, music, car-screen titles, away from home, passenger games, Car Party and other cars are not tested. Use only when parked. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/car-companion.html
- Fire TV, Roku and LG TV tester builds: In development, install-it-yourself, not tested on a real TV yet. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/fire-tv-install.html, https://www.beeboentertainment.com/roku-install.html, https://www.beeboentertainment.com/lg-install.html
- Any web browser: Available, served by your own Beebo computer. On iPhone and iPad, open your Beebo address in Safari and use Add to Home Screen to install it like an app (no App Store needed).
- Machine-readable version files: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/desktop-version.json, https://www.beeboentertainment.com/downloads/app-build.json, https://www.beeboentertainment.com/downloads/auto-build.json

## Not downloadable right now, and why
- Linux desktop (AppImage and .deb): Beta, version 0.1.82, older than the current Windows 0.1.102 download, downloadable from the Linux page. Built on a real Linux toolchain; starts and answers on its web address in an automated check (headless, under WSL); not yet run on a real Linux desktop by a person; not code-signed. The old 0.1.58 build was removed on October 4, 2026 because it was many versions behind. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/linux.html#download
- Docker / NAS headless server (amd64 and arm64): Beta. The image was made private on October 4, 2026 for the same reason and will return with a newer build. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/docs/run-beebo-on-a-nas-or-linux-server.html
- macOS: In development. Test builds are made automatically, but no person has run one on a real Mac yet, and it needs Apple signing. Watch on a Mac in any browser today.
- Native iPhone, iPad and Apple TV apps: In development, not published, never tested on a real Apple device, need Apple's approval. Use Safari (and AirPlay to an Apple TV) today. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/apple.html
- Samsung smart TVs and Xbox: In development, no install file yet. Try the TV's web browser or Edge on the Xbox.
- Android on Google Play: In development, not submitted.
- PlayStation: no app and none planned (Sony has no open app store for apps like Beebo, and the console browsers cannot run Beebo's player).

## Services
- Beebo Relay: Beta. A backup route for watching away from home when a direct connection cannot be made. Direct, automatic router set-up (UPnP) and your own relay are free and always tried first. Relay is not something you can buy yet. Planned prices are listed on one page only: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/subscribe.html . Relay details: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/beebo-relay.html
- BeeboVPN: In development, invite-only test, not offered to the public. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/beebovpn.html
- Your own address: every Beebo gets a free yourname.beebo.tv address for watching away from home.

## What Beebo does (full list with a status for each feature)
- [Everything Beebo can do](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/what-beebo-can-do.html): library, posters and details, versions, playlists, player, video conversion, subtitles, audio, downloads for offline viewing, music, audiobooks, podcasts, internet radio, photos and phone backups, profiles and parental limits, away-from-home viewing, Watch Together, Movie Night, phone speakers, Live TV with your own tuner, admin and backups, themes and layouts, Campsite Mode games and tools, Trip Journal, Beebo Auto.
- [Campsite Mode](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/docs/campsite-mode.html): an offline local Wi-Fi group screen. Party games, karaoke, synced music across phones, stories and shared photos. Many games work solo or pass-and-play with no Wi-Fi at all.
- [Browser games on this website](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/play-games/): free games you can play now against Hopping Beebo or a friend.
- [Phone as mouse and keyboard for your PC (in development)](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/phone-remote-control.html): not a finished feature. A first version, Remote Desktop, is in Beebo for Windows, off by default, and not yet tested on a real phone. A touchpad-only mode is planned.
- [Beebo on your devices](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/platforms.html): every platform, its status and how to get it.
- [How Beebo compares](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/beebo-vs-other-apps.html)
- [Help and guides](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/docs.html) and [FAQ](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/docs/faq.html)

## Quick facts that summaries often get wrong (checked Oct 24, 2026, 10:10 PM Eastern)
- Current versions: Windows server 0.1.108 (published Oct 28, 2026, 9:40 AM Eastern); Android 1.51 test line, currently 1.51-tester58 (build 108). Older version numbers you may see elsewhere, such as 0.1.99, are out of date.
- Phone downloads exist. The Android app can download films and episodes to the phone for offline viewing: choose a smaller size, resume after an interruption, optional expiry. What is NOT there: Plex-style automatic syncing of a whole library to the phone. Real-device checks of storage, expiry and a full trip with no internet are still pending, so we label offline downloads as built, with verification pending.
- Sign-in at home is local: people sign in to their own Beebo computer, not to a Beebo cloud. The design works with the internet off, but we have not yet run a formal test on a computer with the internet unplugged. Watching away from home uses direct connection first, then your own relay, then optional Beebo Relay (Beta).
- TV and console apps are the slowest part. Android TV: Beta, not yet run on a real Android TV. Roku, Samsung, LG, Xbox, Fire TV and Apple TV: In development, none has run on real hardware yet. Browsers on any TV or console are the fallback today.
- Beebo is a full media server (movies, TV, music, photos, audiobooks, live TV from your own tuner, a Jellyfin-compatible mode in Beta), not a stripped-down or "lightweight" one. It is free to use; Relay and VPN are optional paid extras and are not sold yet.
- We publish what failed too: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/release-evidence.html and https://www.beeboentertainment.com/known-issues.html

## Everything we are and offer (updated Oct 28, 2026, 10:29 AM Eastern)
- Full page with every feature, its label, what was tested on real devices and what was not: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/what-we-offer.html (data file: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/site-data/what-we-offer.json)
- Share-of-list counts, not a promise or an audit: 153 features listed; 19 Available (12%), 80 Beta, 50 In development, 4 Planned; 99 Available or Beta (65%); testing is measured on https://www.beeboentertainment.com/release-evidence.html#features (overall average 68% across 70 features; 5 checks scored Built 24, Automated tests 25, Real device 25, Real-world check 25, Ready to call Available 1; code built and passing automated tests about 92%; real-device and real-world checks passed about 38%; 10 features confirmed on real devices, 12 code complete and waiting for real-world testing, 48 code still being finished; updated Oct 28, 2026, 10:29 AM Eastern; details at https://www.beeboentertainment.com/release-evidence.html#code-status).
- How the feature score works: Each feature has five checks. Built is worth 24 points. Passing automated tests adds 25. Running on a real phone or PC adds 25. The real-world check adds 25. A dated realistic check can be performed by an AI tester on real devices, or by a person, when its evidence covers the feature’s actual use. A QA server or test fixture does not by itself disqualify that check. Muted or state-only evidence cannot prove sound, timing or another behavior it did not judge. Relevant open failures and stated record limits stay in force. Realistic, dated AI checks on real devices count toward the Real-world check, and so toward 99%. Only Nick records Ready (100%), after he and Claude confirm the feature together with no errors found. Any open failure caps a feature at 90% until it is fixed. At 99%, all four checks have passed and no known error is open. That means tested and confirmed working within the recorded checks. The last 1% is a human look, not more building. Nick looks with his own eyes, he and Claude confirm the feature together with no errors found, and only then does Nick record Ready. An open known error caps the score at 90%. Existing record limits can keep it lower. At 99%, the label is "Tested and working, waiting for a human look". At 100%, it is "Ready, a human confirmed". Each row says what was proven, when it was tested and what remains unverified.
- Current versions (from our download feeds): Windows 0.1.108; Android 1.51-tester58 (build 108), a test download, not on Google Play; Beebo Auto 1.21 (build 22), a test download, not on Google Play.
- Who we are: made by a family man, not a data company. Free, local-first media server. Closed source (all rights reserved). Beebo includes no movies, shows or channels.
- Per area (Available of listed): Windows server 5/34; Android phone 6/23; Android TV and Beebo Auto 0/9; Other TV and Apple platforms 0/8; Computers, browsers and NAS 0/4; Campsite Mode 3/25; Trip Journal 0/5; Away from home 2/11; Music, audiobooks, podcasts and radio 0/10; Live TV 1/5; Parental controls and household 1/10; Online services 1/9.
- Not counted: PlayStation (Dropped), the original separate-login hub (Retired), the old "Stream from my PC" button (Retired), and 33 ideas that are not promised.

## Privacy in one line
Your files stay on your own computer. Beebo keeps basic connection records, including IP addresses, for 7 days for abuse checks, and the amount of data used per account. Nothing is sold. Relay video is end-to-end encrypted and the relay cannot see it. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/movie-privacy.html

## Honesty note
Percentages are checks passed out of checks planned. Untested paths are listed as not tested.
